programs.title: We Don't Need A Map
programs.desc: Filmmaker Warwick Thornton investigates our relationship to the Southern Cross, in this fun and thought provoking ride through Australia's cultural and political landscape.

programs.title: Blackfellas
programs.desc: Based on The Day of The Dog by Archie Weller, this film tells of an Aboriginal man caught between his allegiance to his people and his aspirations to escape the cycle of self-destructive behaviour.

programs.title: An Unfinished Life
programs.desc: A woman and her daughter move in with her estranged father-in-law in order to escape an abusive lover and hopefully mend the old wounds from their past, which leads to them rediscovering the family bond that was once unbreakable.

programs.title: Master Cheng (A Spice For Life)
programs.desc: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai.

programs.title: The Movie Show
programs.desc: Highlights from the Film Critics Awards Night, honouring John Seale, with wins for Sam Neill and Jane Campion. Plus reviews of Driving Miss Daisy and more.

programs.title: Alick & Albert
programs.desc: Even though they live worlds apart, Torres Strait artist and activist Alick Tipoti and His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco unite to help protect the Ocean.
